title: Slider
description: A slider for interactive compositions (volume, speed, difficulty, a guess on a scale): a label and its formatted value over a track and a thumb. The track is a range region: the runtime turns a drag (snapped to `step`) or the arrow keys (once focused) into a value and emits change with it. Bind `value` to a variable: the filled track and the thumb follow, glide when the value jumps, a bubble shows the value while dragging, ticks mark the steps. Hover halo, focus ring; a thumb-sized target on a phone. Takes a theme.

label.description: Its name, above the track at the left (empty: none)

value.description: The value: bind it to a number variable ({ "$var": "volume" })

step.description: The value snaps to multiples of it from min (0: continuous); also the arrow key step

display.description: value: the number with prefix, suffix and decimals; percent: where it is between min and max; auto: the value when a prefix, suffix or decimals are set or the range is not 0 to 1, else the percentage

ticks.description: Marks at the steps (auto: when there are 2 to 12)

size.description: Thumb diameter in % of the frame's short side (the hit region is at least 11)

textSize.description: Label size in % of the frame's short side

color.description: Fill colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

outDur.description: Seconds of the exit at the item's end (0 while a scene holds for input)
